---
title: code-line-fragment-indices knitr
format:
  revealjs: default
  html: default
execute:
  echo: true
_quarto:
  tests:
    revealjs:
      ensureHtmlElements:
        -
          - 'div[data-code-line-numbers="|1|2"][data-code-line-fragment-indices="1,2"]'
          - 'div[data-code-line-numbers="|1"][data-code-line-fragment-indices="3"]'
          - 'div[data-code-line-numbers="|1"][data-code-line-fragment-indices="5"]'
          - 'div[data-code-line-numbers="|1|2"][data-code-line-fragment-indices="4,6"]'
        -
          - 'div[data-code-line-numbers="1,2"][data-code-line-fragment-indices]'
    html:
      ensureHtmlElements:
        - []
        -
          - '[data-code-line-fragment-indices]'
---

## Stepped cell

```{r}
#| code-line-numbers: "|1|2"
#| code-line-fragment-indices: "1,2"
x <- 1
y <- 2
```

## Not stepped cell

```{r}
#| code-line-numbers: "1,2"
#| code-line-fragment-indices: "1,2"
x <- 1
y <- 2
```

## Number value

```{r}
#| code-line-numbers: "|1"
#| code-line-fragment-indices: 5
x <- 1
y <- 2
```

## List value

```{r}
#| code-line-numbers: "|1|2"
#| code-line-fragment-indices: [4, 6]
x <- 1
y <- 2
```

## Fenced block

```{.r code-line-numbers="|1" code-line-fragment-indices="3"}
x <- 1
y <- 2
```
